peliculas.titulo: Matchstick Productions Presents: The Way Out
peliculas.sinopsis: Matchstick Productions returns with their 34th annual ski film, "The Way Out," a raw tribute to the timeless culture and lifestyle of skiing.
An orphan boy named Tim is afraid of the dark. However, when the stars start going out in the sky, he finds himself exploring the world of the night, alongside his new friend, the Cat Shepherd.
Five short films with range, from big mountain skiing and storytelling to humor, followed by a Q+A and poster signing with the athletes and filmmakers.

Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson became extreme sports stars in 2018 when they were the first to ski down Lhotse, the fourth tallest mountain in the world. For their next challenge, the couple intended to scale Everest's rarely attempted north face and then ski down from the summit.

peliculas.titulo: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
peliculas.sinopsis: When a theft goes awry, a veteran pickpocket is sent on a mission through New York to reclaim it.
CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing mission from Santiago to Easter Island during 1973 in Chile.
The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

peliculas.titulo: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
peliculas.sinopsis: Wallace and his loyal dog, Gromit, set out to discover the mystery behind the garden sabotage that plagues their village and threatens the annual giant vegetable growing contest.
A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.
